review_text: The course was extremely helpful since the work area utilizes scrum and kanban frameworks.
Marcelo was a great instructor. Very upbeat and knowledgeable. Taking the class helped me understand Scrum so much better than before. Would highly recommend him as an instructor.

What I appreciated most was his ability to connect Scrum principles to practical scenarios, helping us understand how to apply them effectively within teams and organizations. He created a supportive learning environment where questions were encouraged, discussions were meaningful, and learning felt collaborative. This bootcamp significantly strengthened my understanding of the Scrum framework and the role of a Scrum Master. I highly recommend this training to anyone looking to deepen their Agile knowledge or prepare for a Scrum Master role. It was truly a fantastic learning experience.

I recently completed the Scrum Master Bootcamp with Professor Trainer Marcelo Lopez, and it was an outstanding experience. Marcelo has an exceptional ability to explain Agile and Scrum concepts in a way that is both clear and engaging. He breaks down complex topics into practical, easy-to-understand components, making it simple to grasp not just the theory but also the real-world application. His teaching style is dynamic, structured, and highly interactive, which kept the sessions engaging from start to finish.

The 2-day course is well structured, timed appropriately and promotes collaboration and teamwork amongst the course attendees, in lieu of direct facilitation from the instructor. Our instructor, Marcelo, is deeply knowledgeable in the subject material and regularly used actual examples from his past experience to bring the concepts to life. This practice made the material easier to digest and understand. I would recommend this course to anyone looking to obtain the CSM certification.
Absolutely worth the time, effort, and cost.. Instructor Lopez was super informative and insightful about the content and how to apply context in day to day application.

The course content was fantastic. Marcelo’s knowledge, energy and enthusiasm is contagious! I recommend him highly!!! He is truly the best
